parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the time period. The value must be 1 to 64 characters in length. Each Chinese character occupies two characters.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the time period. The value is in the 24-hour format and ranges from 00:00 to 23:59. The value cannot be earlier than StartTime.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

parameters.name: PeriodCode
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the time period.

parameters.name: SoundCodeContent
parameters.description: The sound code parsing content for the time period. The value must be 1 to 512 characters in length. Each Chinese character occupies two characters.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the time period. The value is in the 24-hour format and ranges from 00:00 to 23:59.
